services.desc: Flowering plants surround the house and line the paths leading down to the river’s edge, forming a scenic backdrop for special occasions of all kinds. The patio and pool were added after Ann Haig-Brown was inspired by beautiful gardens she had seen in Italy. services.name: Lessons Learned from Haig-Brown
services.desc: “A river is water in its loveliest form; rivers have life and sound and movement and infinity of variation, rivers are veins of the earth through which the lifeblood returns to the heart.” - Roderick Haig-Brown Nestled on the banks of the Campbell River, the Haig-Brown Heritage Property is a place where nature and history intertwine. Visitors to this site are welcomed by the ever-present sound of flowing water. It was this familiar sound that immediately resonated with Celia Haig-Brown when she returned to her childhood home this past November.
